sourceRefs.locator: Inventory 2192. Description, provenance and colophon, AH 964. Fol. 1a for the tuğra, 9b–10a for the Jerusalem buildings, 12a–14b for expenditure, 49a for the founder’s seal and witnesses.
Introduction pp. 1–3, translation of the foundation conditions and map I.1 of the kitchen on the lane above al-Wad. Chapter 2, pp. 39–70, especially pp. 46–65 on revenues, employees and provisioning.

note.de: Hürrems Stiftungsbuch aus Istanbul nennt die Gebäude und die Ausgaben für Löhne und Reinigung. Der Kolophon datiert die Handschrift auf 964 AH.
note.en: Hürrem’s foundation charter from Istanbul names the buildings and specifies spending on wages and cleaning. Its colophon dates it to AH 964.
